properties.description: The two legs missing since v0.35.0 around set_capability_signature. Instruction leg: genesis, capture-intent and adopt's recover step carry the question in the user's domain words ("what goes into it, what comes out?") and write the signature at capture; add_capability's loop_hint names set_capability_signature as the next call when inputs/outputs were not given. Absence leg: one detector, keyed on the practice (aggregate_gap_keying), reports "N of M capabilities carry no signature" with the list, at low severity — never one finding per capability. Planned 2026-09-13.
properties.name: The guided capture paths ask each capability what it takes in and gives out, add_capability names the signature as the next call, and the unsigned fraction is one aggregate finding
